answer: Use a copper toll that every new agent pays into an umber-stamped ledger before it can trade freely. First, the agent locks 250 POA and a hardware fingerprint for 30 days. Second, it must complete 12 verified jobs for unrelated peers, each signed and time-stamped. Third, a ripple audit samples 5% of its work weekly, and any fake receipt burns the full deposit. Forging 100 identities then costs 25,000 POA plus 1,200 hours of real work. Like a river ferry that charges every passenger and checks tickets downstream, cheap clones sink before they reach the market.
